s0401.literal: Nianhe Nanhe, Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat, was appointed Grand Councillor.
s0401.idiomatic: Nianhe Nanhe, right vice director of the Central Secretariat, was made grand councillor.

s0402.literal: Du Wang Mingya, Pacification and Pacification Commissioner of the Six Fan of Qiongbuchuan, was killed by Jiandu of the neighboring state; an edict ordered his son Botuo to succeed to the office and granted him a gold tally.
s0402.idiomatic: Du Wang Mingya, pacification and pacification commissioner of the Six Fan of Qiongbuchuan, was killed by Jiandu of the neighboring state; the court ordered his son Botuo to succeed him and granted a gold tally.

s0403.literal: In the sixth month, on yisi day, Wang E and Yao Shu were summoned to Shangdu.
s0403.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yisi day, Wang E and Yao Shu were summoned to Shangdu.

s0404.literal: Song Military Commissioner Xia Gui led troops intending to attack Huxiao Mountain; an edict ordered one army under wanhu Shimo Qočazha to reinforce Qincha's garrison there.
s0404.idiomatic: Song Military Commissioner Xia Gui marched to attack Huxiao Mountain; the court ordered one army under wanhu Shimo Qočazha to reinforce Qincha's garrison.

s0405.literal: On wushen day, the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn, came to court.
s0405.idiomatic: On wushen day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo came to court.

s0406.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu day, a comet appeared from the Ghost asterism; at dusk it was seen in the northwest, pierced the Upper Platform, swept through Purple Forbidden, Literary Glory, and the Northern Dipper, and at dawn was seen in the northeast — in all more than forty days.
s0406.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu day, a comet rose from the Ghost asterism; at dusk it showed in the northwest, cut through the Upper Platform, swept Purple Forbidden, Literary Glory, and the Northern Dipper, and at dawn appeared in the northeast — for more than forty days in all.

s0407.literal: On Ahmad's recommendation, the salt levy of Jie Prefecture was increased, taxes were equalized among Buddhist and Daoist clergy, military artisan households, and the like; small-scale salt in Taiyuan was left to the people's convenience.
s0407.idiomatic: On Ahmad's recommendation the salt levy of Jie Prefecture was raised, taxes were equalized across Buddhist and Daoist clergy, military artisan households, and similar categories, and small-scale salt production in Taiyuan was left to local convenience.

s0408.literal: On guiwei day, Xin Feng Prefecture was renamed Hui Prefecture.
s0408.idiomatic: On guiwei day Xin Feng Prefecture was renamed Hui Prefecture.

s0409.literal: Anxi Prefecture was established for the eighteen tribes of the Western Barbarians, with the Pacification Commission administering its affairs.
s0409.idiomatic: Anxi Prefecture was established for the eighteen tribes of the Western Barbarians, with a pacification commission placed in charge.

s0410.literal: On dinghai day, the encampments, military, and civilians under Prince Suanji suffered fire; grain was issued to relieve them.
s0410.idiomatic: On dinghai day fire destroyed the encampments, troops, and civilians under Prince Suanji; grain was issued for relief.

s0411.literal: On gengyin day, Prince Yesubuge was granted a seal.
s0411.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince Yesubuge received a seal.

s0412.literal: On renchen day, a special edict addressed Wang Weizheng, commander of the Gongchang Route, with words of praise and encouragement, granted thirty thousand strings of Yuanbao paper notes, and ordered him to continue garrisoning Qingju.
s0412.idiomatic: On renchen day a special edict praised and encouraged Wang Weizheng, commander of the Gongchang route, granted him thirty thousand strings of Yuanbao paper notes, and ordered him to remain on garrison at Qingju.

s0413.literal: Prince Yisibuge was granted a seal, and hunting households from the previous reign were also granted to him.
s0413.idiomatic: Prince Yisibuge received a seal, along with hunting households granted from the previous reign.

s0414.literal: On dingyou day, the Yu Temple at Longmen was completed; the attendant minister Aqutayin was ordered to perform the sacrifice in the Emperor's stead.
s0414.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Yu Temple at Longmen was completed, and attendant minister Aqutayin was ordered to perform the sacrifice in the Emperor's place.

s0415.literal: On jihai day, regulations for the use of imperial seals were fixed: for all appointments and orders, ranks one and two used jade, ranks three to five used gold.
s0415.idiomatic: On jihai day rules for imperial seals were fixed: appointments and orders for ranks one and two used jade, ranks three through five used gold.

s0416.literal: That whose inscription read "Imperial Traveling Seal" was cast at accession and was used only for edicts and patents;
s0416.idiomatic: The seal inscribed "Imperial Traveling Seal" was cast at accession and was reserved for edicts and patents;

s0417.literal: A separate gold seal for appointments and orders was cast for that purpose.
s0417.idiomatic: a separate gold seal for appointments and orders was cast for that use.

s0418.literal: On gengzi day, Ariq Böke, since his defeat at Shimultu, had been unable to maintain an army; now he came over together with Princes Yisibuge, Asudai, and Shirigin and their plotting ministers Buluqan, Qoča, Tumen, Ariqa, and Toqosi.
s0418.idiomatic: On gengzi day Ariq Böke, unable to keep an army since his defeat at Shimultu, came over with Princes Yisibuge, Asudai, and Shirigin and their plotting ministers Buluqan, Qoča, Tumen, Ariqa, and Toqosi.

s0419.literal: An edict stated that all princes were descendants of Taizu and were pardoned without question; their plotting ministers Buluqan and the others were all executed.
s0419.idiomatic: An edict declared that all princes, as descendants of Taizu, were pardoned without inquiry; their plotting ministers Buluqan and the others were all put to death.

s0420.literal: In the eighth month, on the renyin new moon, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat officials memorialized: "For the military needs of Sichuan garrison troops, we ask that ordo offices collect revenue into government treasuries and issue documents to nearby garrison offices to take supplies according to quantity.
s0420.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the eighth month, officials of the Shaanxi branch secretariat memorialized: "For the needs of Sichuan garrison troops, ordo offices should collect revenue into government treasuries and issue documents to nearby garrison offices to draw supplies in the proper amounts.

s0421.literal: Newly submitted Song people should be allotted land, clothing, and grain, given oxen and seed, and frontier generals should be forbidden to conceal people in their households.
s0421.idiomatic: Newly submitted Song people should receive land, clothing, and grain, be given oxen and seed, and frontier generals should be forbidden to hide people in their households.

s0422.literal: Shang Prefecture is strategically vital; we ask that the garrison be increased.
s0422.idiomatic: Shang Prefecture is strategically vital; we ask that its garrison be reinforced.

s0423.literal: Shaanxi hunting households should be moved to hunt at Shang Prefecture.
s0423.idiomatic: Shaanxi hunting households should be transferred to hunt in Shang Prefecture.

s0424.literal: Garrison-farming troops of Hexi and Fengxiang should be transferred to garrison Xingyuan.
s0424.idiomatic: Garrison-farming troops from Hexi and Fengxiang should be moved to garrison Xingyuan.

s0425.literal: For each wing army in Sichuan, those with land should pay tax, and those without land should receive grain.
s0425.idiomatic: For each wing army in Sichuan, households with land should pay tax and those without land should receive grain.

s0427.literal: On jiachen day, an edict ordered the Qin-Shu Branch Secretariat to issue two hundred fifty thousand taels of silver for the annual expenses of the frontier.
s0427.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Qin-Shu branch secretariat was ordered to release two hundred fifty thousand taels of silver for annual frontier expenses.

s0428.literal: On yisi day, the Shandong Branch Central Secretariat was established, with Left Grand Councillor Yelü Zhuo, Vice Administrator Zhang Hui, and others administering branch secretariat affairs.
s0428.idiomatic: On yisi day the Shandong branch central secretariat was established, with Left Grand Councillor Yelü Zhuo, Vice Administrator Zhang Hui, and others to run its affairs.

s0429.literal: An edict promulgated new regulations: prefectures and counties were to be consolidated, official posts and numbers fixed, ranks and duties assigned, salaries granted, public fields distributed, and monthly and yearly performance assessed;
s0429.idiomatic: An edict promulgated new regulations: consolidate prefectures and counties, fix official posts and numbers, assign ranks and duties, grant salaries, distribute public fields, and assess performance by month and year;

s0430.literal: equalize taxes and corvée, and recruit displaced people;
s0430.idiomatic: equalize taxes and corvée and recruit displaced people;

s0431.literal: forbid unauthorized use of government goods, presenting government goods as tribute, or borrowing and exchanging government funds;
s0431.idiomatic: forbid unauthorized use of government property, presenting government goods as tribute, or borrowing and trading government funds;

s0433.literal: troops and horses must not be quartered in villages and wards, and lawsuits must not be appealed across jurisdictions;
s0433.idiomatic: troops and horses must not be quartered in villages and wards, and lawsuits must not bypass proper jurisdiction;

s0434.literal: relieve widows and orphans, encourage farming and sericulture, inspect rainfall, and stabilize prices;
s0434.idiomatic: relieve widows and orphans, encourage farming and sericulture, inspect rainfall, and stabilize prices;

s0435.literal: record numbers of robberies and prisoners and report monthly to the secretariat and ministries.
s0435.idiomatic: record robberies and prisoners and report monthly to the secretariat and ministries.

s0436.literal: Regulations for the branch secretariats at Shaanxi-Sichuan, Western Xia Zhongxing, and Beijing were also promulgated.
s0436.idiomatic: Regulations for the branch secretariats at Shaanxi-Sichuan, Western Xia Zhongxing, and Beijing were also issued.

s0437.literal: Regulations were fixed for princes' envoys, relay transport, taxes, levies, and corvée; unauthorized recruitment of households was forbidden, silver might not be lent through otog offices to persons outside appanages, oral transmission of edicts was forbidden, and summoning secretariat officials by princes was forbidden.
s0437.idiomatic: Rules were fixed for princes' envoys, relay transport, taxes, levies, and corvée; princes might not recruit households on their own, lend silver through otog offices to persons outside appanages, pass edicts by word of mouth, or summon secretariat officials.

s0438.literal: An edict stated: "Among Mongol households farming fields, those with horses, cattle, and sheep shall have their grain rations stopped;
s0438.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Among Mongol households who farm, those with horses, cattle, and sheep shall cease receiving grain rations;

s0439.literal: those without fields shall still receive them.
s0439.idiomatic: those without fields shall still receive rations.

s0440.literal: " On gengxu day, the Prince of Yan was ordered to sign edicts; princes were to establish staff and lecturing officers.
s0440.idiomatic: " On gengxu day the Prince of Yan was ordered to sign edicts, and princes were told to establish staff and lecturing officers.

s0441.literal: Relay-station households were limited to four qing of tax-exempt land to supply relay horses and attendants;
s0441.idiomatic: Relay-station households were granted four qing of tax-exempt land to supply relay horses and attendants;

s0442.literal: route chief administrators were ordered concurrently to oversee the matter.
s0442.idiomatic: route chief administrators were ordered to oversee the matter concurrently.

s0443.literal: On guichou day, the monk Zizong was ordered to deliberate jointly on Bureau of Military Affairs affairs.
s0443.idiomatic: On guichou day the monk Zizong was ordered to join in deliberations at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

s0444.literal: An edict restored Zizong to his surname Liu, changed his name to Bingzhong, invested him as Grand Preceptor, and made him participate in directing Central Secretariat affairs.
s0444.idiomatic: An edict restored Zizong to the surname Liu, changed his name to Bingzhong, invested him as grand preceptor, and made him participate in directing Central Secretariat affairs.

s0445.literal: On yimao day, an edict changed Yanjing to Zhongdu; Daxing Prefecture remained as before.
s0445.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict renamed Yanjing Zhongdu; Daxing Prefecture remained unchanged.

s0446.literal: Monthly salaries of secretariat assistant clerks were increased.
s0446.idiomatic: Monthly salaries for secretariat assistant clerks were raised.

s0447.literal: On bingchen day, Liu Bingzhong, Wang E, Zhang Wenqian, and Shang Ting stated that since the Prince of Yan already held the chancellorship, a separate office should be set up within the secretariat where he would come once or twice a month to decide and sign state affairs.
s0447.idiomatic: On bingchen day Liu Bingzhong, Wang E, Zhang Wenqian, and Shang Ting argued that since the Prince of Yan already held the chancellorship, the secretariat should set up a separate office where he would come once or twice a month to decide and sign state affairs.

s0448.literal: For lecturing officers, the prince Mang'an was given Li Pan, and Namuhe was given Gao Dao.
s0448.idiomatic: As lecturing officers, Prince Mang'an was given Li Pan and Prince Namuhe was given Gao Dao.

s0449.literal: On dingsi day, on the occasion of changing the era name, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; the edict stated:
s0449.idiomatic: On dingsi day, on changing the era name, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; the edict stated:

s0450.literal: On wuwu day, winter clothing was granted to one thousand men of the Yidu Wuwei Guard.
s0450.idiomatic: On wuwu day one thousand men of the Yidu Wuwei Guard received winter clothing.

s0451.literal: On jiwei day, Chaoguo and others, monks of Longquan Temple in Fengxiang Prefecture, had plotted rebellion but encountered the amnesty; their property was confiscated and they were placed under restraint by the Jingzhao Buddhist office;
s0451.idiomatic: On jiwei day Chaoguo and other monks of Longquan Temple in Fengxiang Prefecture, though they had plotted rebellion, encountered the amnesty; their property was confiscated and they were placed under restraint by the Jingzhao Buddhist office;

s0452.literal: Su De, a co-conspirator, was ordered to serve in the army to redeem himself.
s0452.idiomatic: Su De, a co-conspirator, was ordered to serve in the army to redeem himself.

s0453.literal: One thousand men under wanhu Shimo Qočazha were sent to farm at Shang Prefecture; six hundred eight Bozhou troops and sixty Henan Prefecture troops were sent to help Qincha garrison Qingju.
s0453.idiomatic: One thousand men under wanhu Shimo Qočazha were sent to farm at Shang Prefecture, while six hundred eight Bozhou troops and sixty Henan Prefecture troops were sent to reinforce Qincha at Qingju.

s0454.literal: An edict ordered Shandong Frontier Deputy Commissioner Wu Xiu to select one thousand new troops from Yidu to fill the Wuwei Guard and march them to Zhongdu.
s0454.idiomatic: The court ordered Shandong frontier deputy commissioner Wu Xiu to select one thousand new Yidu troops for the Wuwei Guard and march them to Zhongdu.

s0455.literal: Tan city was walled, and troops under Yizhou battle overseer Tasi and wanhu Meng Yi were stationed to garrison it.
s0455.idiomatic: Tan was walled, and troops under Yizhou battle overseer Tasi and wanhu Meng Yi were posted to garrison it.

s0456.literal: You Mangwudai, chief administrator of the Taiyuan Route, was dismissed from office and reduced to commoner status for concealing armor and hiding households.
s0456.idiomatic: You Mangwudai, chief administrator of the Taiyuan route, was dismissed and reduced to commoner status for concealing armor and hiding households.

s0457.literal: In the ninth month, on the renshen new moon, the Hanlin Imperial History Academy was established.
s0457.idiomatic: On the renshen new moon of the ninth month the Hanlin Imperial History Academy was established.

s0458.literal: The edict on changing the era name was sent to instruct Goryeo, and amnesty was also granted within its territory.
s0458.idiomatic: The era-change edict was sent to instruct Goryeo, and amnesty was also granted within its territory.

s0459.literal: On xinsi day, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0459.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Emperor returned from Shangdu.

s0460.literal: On gengyin day, Mao Zhang of Yidu plotted rebellion; his two sons and his follower Cui Cheng were all executed, his household property was confiscated, and it was granted to Branch Secretariat Governor Sagis.
s0460.idiomatic: On gengyin day Mao Zhang of Yidu plotted rebellion; his two sons and follower Cui Cheng were executed, his property confiscated, and granted to branch secretariat governor Sagis.

s0461.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the renyin new moon, the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn, came to court.
s0461.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the tenth month of winter King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo came to court.

s0462.literal: On yisi day, hunting within the Shangdu metropolitan region was forbidden.
s0462.idiomatic: On yisi day hunting within the Shangdu metropolitan region was forbidden.

s0463.literal: On gengxu day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0463.idiomatic: On gengxu day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0464.literal: On renzi day, Liting County in En Prefecture presented auspicious grain, one stalk with five ears.
s0464.idiomatic: On renzi day Liting County in En Prefecture presented auspicious grain, one stalk bearing five ears.

s0465.literal: On wuchen day, the Wuwei Guard was renamed the Palace Guard.
s0465.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Wuwei Guard was renamed the Palace Guard.

s0466.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingzi day, an edict ordered that Song people who submitted and northerners captured by the enemy who came over should all receive monthly grain rations.
s0466.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the eleventh month an edict ordered monthly grain rations for Song people who submitted and northerners captured by the enemy who returned.

s0467.literal: On xinsi day, Kuryu was attacked.
s0467.idiomatic: On xinsi day an expedition was launched against Kuryu.

s0468.literal: Earlier, when the Gilyak submitted, they reported that east of their country were the two tribes of Kuryu and Yiliyu, which each year invaded their borders; hence the expedition.
s0468.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Gilyak submitted, they reported that east of their country lay the two tribes of Kuryu and Yiliyu, which raided their borders every year; hence the expedition.

s0469.literal: On jichou day, the calendar for the second year of the Zhiyuan era was granted to the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn.
s0469.idiomatic: On jichou day the calendar for the second year of the Zhiyuan era was granted to King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo.

s0470.literal: Jurchen from Dengzhou, He Prefecture, and other places were forbidden to cross into Goryeo to plunder.
s0470.idiomatic: Jurchen from Dengzhou, He Prefecture, and other places were forbidden to cross into Goryeo to raid.

s0471.literal: On xinmao day, Li Jushou, fifth-generation lineage master of the Taiyi sect in Weizhou, was summoned to court.
s0471.idiomatic: On xinmao day Li Jushou, fifth-generation lineage master of the Taiyi sect in Weizhou, was summoned to court.

s0472.literal: On renchen day, the Left and Right Departments of the Central Secretariat were abolished and merged into the Central Secretariat.
s0472.idiomatic: On renchen day the left and right departments of the Central Secretariat were abolished and merged into the secretariat.

s0473.literal: Ahmad, who headed the Left and Right Departments of the Central Secretariat and concurrently served as Commissioner of Transport for All Routes and Director of the Imperial Storehouse, was made Grand Councillor; Ali, who headed the Left and Right Departments and concurrently served as Commissioner of Transport for All Routes, was made Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat.
s0473.idiomatic: Ahmad, head of the left and right departments of the Central Secretariat and concurrent commissioner of transport for all routes and director of the imperial storehouse, was made grand councillor; Ali, head of the left and right departments and concurrent commissioner of transport for all routes, was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat.

s0474.literal: On dingyou day, Lin Prefecture in the Taiyuan Route presented auspicious grain with two stalks.
s0474.idiomatic: On dingyou day Lin Prefecture in the Taiyuan route presented auspicious grain with two stalks.

s0475.literal: Marshals Andun, Liu Zheng, Liu Yuanli, Qincha, and other officers and soldiers who had won merit were rewarded in varying amounts.
s0475.idiomatic: Marshals Andun, Liu Zheng, Liu Yuanli, Qincha, and other officers and soldiers who had won merit received rewards in varying amounts.

s0476.literal: In the twelfth month, on yisi day, darughachi of each appanage were abolished, and ceremonial precedence for officials at court and abroad was fixed.
s0476.idiomatic: On yisi day of the twelfth month darughachi of each appanage were abolished, and ceremonial precedence for officials at court and abroad was fixed.

s0477.literal: On dingwei day, an edict ordered four Song spies sent back to their country.
s0477.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict ordered four Song spies sent back to their country.

s0478.literal: On wuwu day, five hundred thousand taels of silver were granted to reward the Badu army.
s0478.idiomatic: On wuwu day five hundred thousand taels of silver were granted to reward the Badu army.

s0479.literal: On jiazi day, the moon infringed upon Fang.
s0479.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon infringed upon Fang.

s0480.literal: On yichou day, because Wang Jian had formerly been envoy to Dali and died in the service of the state, and his son Tianshe could not support himself, special relief was granted.
s0480.idiomatic: On yichou day, because Wang Jian had died on mission to Dali in the service of the state and his son Tianshe could not support himself, special relief was granted.

s0481.literal: On dingmao day, an edict ordered four forts — Zhuyu, Changping, Jianling, and Jiyang — established along the Deng Prefecture frontier.
s0481.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict ordered four forts — Zhuyu, Changping, Jianling, and Jiyang — established along the Deng Prefecture frontier.

s0482.literal: On wuchen day, an order was issued to select one skilled in waterworks to measure the course of the Yellow River as far as Dongsheng to see whether grain transport could pass, and report by relay post.
s0482.idiomatic: On wuchen day the court ordered one skilled in waterworks to survey the Yellow River as far as Dongsheng to determine whether grain transport could pass, and report by relay post.

s0483.literal: On gengwu day, an edict abolished the adjudication officers of the Bureau of Military Affairs and ordo offices on all routes, ordering chief administrators concurrently to oversee general custody offices.
s0483.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict abolished the adjudication officers of the Bureau of Military Affairs and route ordo offices, ordering chief administrators concurrently to oversee general custody offices.

s0484.literal: Hereditary tenure by feudal lords was abolished for the first time, and a rotation system was established.
s0484.idiomatic: Hereditary tenure by feudal lords was abolished for the first time and a rotation system established.

s0485.literal: That year, Zhending, Shuntian, Ming, Ci, Shunde, Daming, Dongping, Cao, Pu, Tai'an, Gaotang, Ji, Bo, De, Jinan, Bin, Di, Zi, Lai, and Hejian suffered great floods.
s0485.idiomatic: That year Zhending, Shuntian, Ming, Ci, Shunde, Daming, Dongping, Cao, Pu, Tai'an, Gaotang, Ji, Bo, De, Jinan, Bin, Di, Zi, Lai, and Hejian suffered major floods.

s0486.literal: Gold, silver, and silks were granted to the princes according to the annual custom.
s0486.idiomatic: Gold, silver, and silks were granted to the princes according to annual custom.

s0487.literal: Households numbered one million five hundred eighty-eight thousand one hundred ninety-five; seventy-three persons were sentenced to death.
s0487.idiomatic: The registered population stood at one million five hundred eighty-eight thousand one hundred ninety-five households; seventy-three persons were sentenced to death.
